title: fix: avoid duplicate recovery after ordinary session interruption
body:
Related: #120315

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes duplicate restart-recovery turns and blocked new messages when an ordinary session interruption is mistaken for a Gateway restart.

## User Impact

Interrupting an active turn lets the new message run without replaying the canceled turn. Stop remains terminal, and genuine Gateway restarts still recover interrupted work once per restart.

## Why This Change Was Made

Five admission paths were replacing ordinary cancellation reasons with restart errors, including the newer outer serialized command admission. Preserve the original reason and use the existing typed restart predicate where an outcome must be selected. The recovery owner receives the correct facts without another classifier, new state, or changes to registry-derived liveness, FIFO admission, exact recovery claims, or yielded continuation custody.

The maintainer revision removes the extra classifier and duplicate synthetic test matrices, updates the existing owner fixtures, and replaces their polling waits with completion signals. Compared with merged main `36bd762422b348173b951819eef29e7fb2d307c3`: production **+23/-39 (-16)**; tests **+175/-141 (+34)**; docs **+1/-1 (0)**. Total: **199 additions, 181 deletions across 11 files**.

Original fix by @Grynn; maintainer cleanup narrows the implementation and completes the owner-level and real Gateway proof. Contributor history is preserved; no rebase or force-push.

## Evidence

Validated head: **`2bae4f34fea3b79faef344006d87021c71c0b3f3`**.

**Before:** On main `76d6104f77234bdba2c953cf0208b19b49f9a36f`, a real isolated Gateway with the mock provider ran an `agent` RPC in a newly created non-main session. Sending `chat.send` with `queueMode: "interrupt"` produced `stopReason: "restart"` without a Gateway restart, started a distinct recovery run, and inserted the false restart prompt. The successor remained `pending`, with `timeoutPhase: "queue"` and `providerStarted: false`. Source comparison through main `bfc578fa5ef7` confirmed the same faulty adapters; its newer ownership contracts are preserved here.

**After:** Fresh secretless AWS proof at the validated head passed all three real Gateway scenarios:

| Scenario | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Interrupt an active direct agent RPC with `chat.send` | Source settled as an ordinary error; successor replied once; another reply succeeded after a later Gateway restart; **0 recovery dispatches**. |
| Stop the exact active run with `chat.abort` | Cancellation receipt named the source run; successor and post-restart replies each appeared once; **0 recovery dispatches**. |
| Interrupt work through three genuine Gateway restarts | **3 recovery dispatches**, **1 final delivery**, **0 resend notices**; restart-safe tool policy retained. |

Both ordinary-cancellation scenarios retained the same session ID. Their saved final entries were `status: "done"`, `abortedLastRun: false`, with no retained recovery cycle, run fence, or delivery-run ID. The only nonempty assistant messages were the two expected markers; no false restart prompt or notice appeared.

The ordinary/Stop driver uses public `sessions.create`, `agent`, `chat.send`/`chat.abort`, `agent.wait`, and `chat.history` through a real Gateway process. It waits until the mock provider receives the active request; it does not synthesize lifecycle events. The genuine-restart proof uses the maintained `gateway-restart-inflight-run` QA scenario.

**Checks:** 992 tests passed across all 32 selected owner/sibling files; `pnpm tsgo:core` and all seven selected core test-type graphs passed; private-QA build, formatting, scoped oxlint, and diff checks passed. The production-only negative control restored all five production files from the merged main while keeping the new tests: the ordinary-interruption regression failed with `expected true to be false`. Restoring the fixed bytes left the checkout clean.

Independent Codex autoreview was scoped-clean through P2 for this exact head. [CI succeeded for this head](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37769298798): 56 successful jobs, 26 skipped jobs, 686 seconds workflow wall time. Successful Node test jobs totaled 6,939 job-seconds; this is shared-shard cost, not an estimate of marginal test cost.

The earlier candidate's full command suite passed 55/57 cases and exposed the still-wrong outer admission conversion. The fix preserves both failed assertions. An earlier CI lint failure came from a newer-main merge-ref test outside this diff; main fixed it in `d1d8b113cdf95`. No CI rerun was requested merely to obtain green.

### Measured test cost

Each complete changed entry point ran with `/usr/bin/time -p pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1` on a two-vCPU, 16-GiB AWS lease:

| Entry point | Tests | Wall seconds |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `src/commands/agent.test.ts` | 57 | 224.89 |
| `src/auto-reply/reply/reply-turn-admission.test.ts` | 21 | 59.00 |
| `src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.lifecycle.test.ts` | 75 | 58.27 |
| `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts` | 393 | 151.05 |
| `src/gateway/server.chat-abort-dispatch-rejection.test.ts` | 6 | 79.90 |

These totals include cold preparation and complete existing owner suites. The command suite crosses real CLI admission and delivery; the Gateway suites cover registration, cancellation, persistence, and single-terminal behavior. A helper-only classifier test would miss the outer-owner defect demonstrated by the first candidate. The three command interruption cases took 2.595, 2.373, and 2.401 seconds; the changes reuse existing fixtures rather than introducing per-test Gateway boots. The remaining 27 files passed 440 tests in seven shards, taking 880.00 seconds.

The trusted main bootstrap verified the full head and no IAM role; lease inspection verified public networking and no Tailscale; `--fresh-pr openclaw/openclaw#154175`, `--no-hydrate`, and `CRABBOX_ENV_ALLOW=CI` kept the run secretless. node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs /tmp/live-agent-interrupt.mjs .artifacts/rel6-154175-fixed-interrupt interrupt
node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs /tmp/live-agent-interrupt.mjs .artifacts/rel6-154175-fixed-stop stop
